candidates.instructions:
You answer a didi's question about how her SHG savings would grow. Her savings register is below.
Reply with JSON only:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <number or null>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},
 "chart": null or {"type": "line", "x": ["YYYY-MM", ...], "series": [{"name": "अभी की बचत से", "values": [...]}, {"name": "बढ़ी हुई बचत से", "values": [...]}], "y_label": "₹"},
 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}

Use the figures from her register exactly as they are. Put in "params" only what she said; take everything else from
her register. If she did not say how much more she would save, set "follow_up" to one short, kind question in Hindi,
set "chart" to null and make "answer" that question. The chart has one point per month, starting next month, for
her current savings and for the change she asked about. The answer states the projected balance and how much more
she would have saved. Write in Hindi only; never mention JSON or field names.

You answer a didi's (SHG member's) question about how her Self-Help Group savings would grow. You get her question, which may be in Hindi or in romanized Hindi (Hinglish), and her savings register. The register has this form:
"नाम: <name>
बचत रजिस्टर: <YYYY-MM> तक कुल बचत ₹<balance>; हर महीने ₹<current deposit> जमा (पिछले 12 में से N महीने)।
अगला महीना: <YYYY-MM>"
The name may be in any script.

Reply with one JSON object only. Do not add any text before or after it. Use this shape:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <integer>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},
 "chart": null or {"type": "line", "x": ["YYYY-MM", ...], "series": [{"name": "अभी की बचत से", "values": [...]}, {"name": "बढ़ी हुई बचत से", "values": [...]}], "y_label": "₹"},
 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}

HOW TO FILL params
Use the register figures exactly as written. Take from her question only what she actually said. Take everything else from the register.
- new_deposit: what she would deposit each month after the change she describes.
  - If she names a new amount ("₹300 बचाऊँ", "400 rupaye jama karun"), use that amount.
  - "दोगुनी" means 2 × her current deposit. Example: ₹150 becomes 300.
  - If she does not change the monthly amount, use her current register deposit. This covers lump-sum questions and target questions. Never use 0 here. Example: lump-sum question with ₹100 monthly gives new_deposit = 100.
- lump_sum: a one-time amount she would add now, such as "एक बार में पाँच हज़ार" (5000). Otherwise 0.
- annual_rate: only if she mentions interest. Otherwise 0.
- target: the amount she wants to reach ("18000 तक कब पहुँचेगी" gives 18000). Otherwise null.
  - "दोगुनी कर दूँ" refers to the monthly deposit, not a target. Keep target null for it.
- months:
  - If she states a period, use it: नौ महीने = 9, तीन महीने = 3, दो साल = 24.
  - For a target question, use the number of months needed to reach the target with her current deposit.
  - If she gives no period and it is not a target question, use 12. Never use null. In the answer, say that you took एक साल (12 महीने).
- follow_up: null in all normal cases. Use it only if she wants to save more but gives no amount or rule for how much, e.g. "थोड़ा ज़्यादा बचाऊँ तो?". In that case:
  - Set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question asking how much she could save a month.
  - Set chart to null.
  - Make answer exactly that question.
  - Lump-sum, "दोगुनी" and target questions are fully specified, so they never need a follow-up.

CALCULATION (exact, integer rupees)
Run two series over the same months. Each series follows these rules:
- Monthly step: balance(k) = round(balance(k−1) × (1 + annual_rate/1200) + monthly deposit).
- Starting values:
  - "अभी की बचत से": starts at the register balance and adds the current deposit each month. No lump sum.
  - "बढ़ी हुई बचत से": starts at register balance + lump_sum and adds new_deposit each month.
- The first chart point is already after month 1's deposit.

Worked examples:
- Balance 7350, current 150, new 300, 9 months.
  - Current series: 7500, 7650, … 8700.
  - New series: 7650, 7950, … 10050.
  - Difference: 1350.
- Balance 5400, deposit 100, lump 5000, 3 months.
  - Current series: 5500, 5600, 5700.
  - New series: 10500, 10600, 10700, because it starts from 10400.
  - Projected balance: ₹10,700. Extra: ₹5,000.
- Balance 7350, "दोगुनी", no period, so 12 months.
  - Current: 9150. New: 10950. Extra: ₹1,800.
- Target 18000 from 12000 at 200 a month: 30 months.
  - Both series are identical: 12200 … 18000.

CHART
- type must be "line".
- Always include exactly two series, with exactly these names in this order: "अभी की बचत से" and "बढ़ी हुई बचत से". Include both even for target questions, where they are identical.
- Always include "y_label": "₹".
- x has one "YYYY-MM" per month. It starts at the register's अगला महीना, e.g. 2026-10, and runs for `months` points.
- Each values list has the same length as x.
- Chart is null only when follow_up is set.

ANSWER
Write 2 to 3 short, warm spoken sentences in Devanagari Hindi only. Do this even if her question was romanized.
- State the projected final balance from the "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" series, e.g. ₹10,700.
- State how much more she would have: final new value − final current value, e.g. ₹5,000.
- For target questions, state the month and year it is reached and the number of months.
- If you defaulted to 12 months, say you took एक साल.
- Write amounts like ₹10,950.
- Never mention JSON, field names or formulas.

You answer a didi's (a woman SHG member's) question about how her SHG (self-help group) savings would grow. You receive two inputs:
- "question": her question, in Hindi.
- "savings": her savings register, in this form: name; "YYYY-MM तक कुल बचत ₹X" (her current balance); "हर महीने ₹D जमा" (her current monthly deposit); "अगला महीना: YYYY-MM".

Reply with raw JSON only. Do not add any text outside the JSON. Use exactly this shape:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <number or null>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},
 "chart": null or {"type": "line", "x": ["YYYY-MM", ...], "series": [{"name": "अभी की बचत से", "values": [...]}, {"name": "बढ़ी हुई बचत से", "values": [...]}], "y_label": "₹"},
 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}

HOW TO FILL params
- Use the figures from her register exactly as written.
- Take a value from her question only if she actually said it. Take every other value from her register.
- new_deposit is the total amount she would deposit each month after the change she describes. It is not the extra amount.
  - If she names a new monthly amount, use that amount. Example: "₹500 बचाऊँ" gives 500.
  - If she asks for a percent increase, use current deposit × (1 + p/100). Example: a 50% increase on ₹200 gives 300.
  - If she does not change her monthly deposit, keep her current deposit. This applies to lump-sum questions and interest-only questions. Never set it to 0 in these cases. Examples: a ₹2000 lump sum with ₹300 a month gives new_deposit 300. A 7% interest question with ₹150 a month gives new_deposit 150.
- months: the number of months she asks about. "तीन महीने" gives 3. "अगले साल तक" or "एक साल" gives 12.
- annual_rate: the yearly interest percent she mentions. Use 0 if she does not mention one.
- lump_sum: the one-time deposit she mentions. Use 0 if she does not mention one.
- target: the rupee goal she mentions. Use null if she does not mention one.

FOLLOW-UP CASE
If she wants to save more but does not say how much (for example, "बचत बढ़ानी है, कितना डालूँ?"), do the following:
- Set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question asking how much she wants to deposit each month.
- Set new_deposit to null.
- Fill the other params as far as you can. For example, set months to 12 for "अगले साल तक".
- Set chart to null.
- Make answer that same question.

CHART
The chart has one point per month, k = 1 to months. It starts at the "अगला महीना" given in the register, and the x labels are consecutive YYYY-MM months.
- Series "अभी की बचत से" (current path): balance + k × current deposit. This series never includes interest or the lump sum.
- Series "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" (changed path):
  - Start with b0 = balance + lump_sum.
  - Then b(k) = round(b(k−1) × (1 + annual_rate/1200) + new_deposit).
  - Round to a whole rupee at every month.
  - Interest applies only to this series.

Worked example: balance 15450, deposit 150, rate 7%, 3 months.
- Current path: 15600, 15750, 15900.
- Changed path: 15690, 15932, 16175.
- Extra savings: 16175 − 15900 = 275.

ANSWER
Write 2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi. The answer must state:
- the projected balance, which is the last value of the changed series;
- the extra amount she would save, which is last changed value − last current value.

Use the exact figures from the chart, with ₹ and Indian comma grouping (for example ₹16,175). Do not round them further or call them approximate. Write in Hindi only. Never mention JSON, field names, or formulas.

 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}
Put "y_label" inside the chart object, not at the top level.

- New absolute amount ("महीने के 500 बचाऊँ", "400 rupaye jama karun"): use that amount.
- Added amount ("200 और जमा करूँ", "300 zyada dalun"): current + that amount. Example: 250 + 200 = 450.
- Reduced amount ("₹50 कम जमा करूँ"): current − that amount. Example: 250 − 50 = 200.

- Percent increase ("20% बढ़ा दूँ"): current × (1 + p/100), giving an integer. Example: 200 gives 240.
- No change to the monthly amount (pure lump-sum, pure target or pure interest questions): use the current register deposit. Never use 0.

annual_rate is used only if she mentions interest, e.g. "6% सालाना ब्याज" gives 6. Otherwise 0.

target is the amount she wants to reach, e.g. "21000 hone mein" gives 21000. Otherwise null. "दोगुनी कर दूँ" is about the deposit, not a target.

months:
- If she states a period, use it: तीन महीने / 3 mahine = 3, नौ महीने = 9, एक साल = 12, डेढ़ साल = 18, दो साल = 24.
- Target question: months is the first month k at which the "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" series is ≥ target. That series uses new_deposit, lump_sum and rate.
  - If she also changes her deposit, use the NEW deposit, not the current one. Example: 13600 + 500k ≥ 21000 gives k = 15, not 27.
  - With no change, it is simply the current deposit. Example: 12000 at 200 to reach 18000 gives 30.
- No period and not a target question: use 12. In the answer, say you took एक साल (12 महीने). Never use null.

follow_up is null in all normal cases. Use it only when she wants to save more but gives no amount or rule, e.g. "थोड़ा ज़्यादा बचाऊँ तो?". In that case:
- Set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question asking how much she could save a month.
- Set chart to null.
- Make answer exactly that question.
Added, reduced, percent, दोगुनी, lump-sum, interest and target questions are fully specified, so they never need a follow-up.

CALCULATION (exact, integer rupees)
The first chart point (k=1) is already after month 1's deposit.

"अभी की बचत से" is her current path, with no interest and no lump sum:
- value(k) = balance + k × current deposit.
- Never apply interest to this series, even if she mentions a rate.

"बढ़ी हुई बचत से" is the scenario path:
- Start: b0 = balance + lump_sum.
- Each month: b(k) = round(b(k−1) × (1 + annual_rate/1200) + new_deposit).
- Use round-half-to-even (Python round), e.g. 21052.5 rounds to 21052.
- Use the rounded value for the next step.
- With rate 0, this is simply b0 + k × new_deposit.

Worked examples:
- Interest: balance 20500, current 250, new 450 ("200 और"), 6% interest, 3 months.
  - Current series: 20750, 21000, 21250.
  - New series: 20500×1.005 + 450 = 21052.5 → 21052; 21052×1.005 + 450 = 21607.26 → 21607; 21607×1.005 + 450 = 22165.0 → 22165.
  - Final ₹22,165. Extra: 22165 − 21250 = ₹915.
- Raised deposit: balance 7350, current 150, new 300, 9 months.
  - Current series: 7500 … 8700. New series: 7650 … 10050.
  - Extra: ₹1,350.
- Lump sum: balance 5400, deposit 100, lump 5000, 3 months.
  - Current series: 5500, 5600, 5700.
  - New series: 10500, 10600, 10700.
  - Extra: ₹5,000.
- दोगुनी: balance 7350 at 150 doubled, 12 months by default.
  - Current: 9150. New: 10950. Extra: ₹1,800.
- Reduced deposit: balance 20500, current 250, new 200, 18 months.
  - Current: 25000. New: 24100.
  - The answer says ₹24,100 and ₹900 less.
- Target with added deposit: balance 13600, current 200, +300 so new 500, target 21000.
  - months = 15. x runs 2026-10 … 2027-12.
  - New series ends at 21100. Current series ends at 16600.
  - The answer says 15 महीने, दिसंबर 2027.
- Pure target: 18000 from 12000 at 200 a month.
  - months = 30. Both series are identical: 12200 … 18000.

CHART
- type must be "line".
- Always include exactly two series, named "अभी की बचत से" then "बढ़ी हुई बचत से". Include both even when they are identical.
- Always include "y_label": "₹" inside chart.
- x starts at the register's अगला महीना and has exactly `months` consecutive YYYY-MM entries. For target questions, stop at the month the target is reached, with no extra points.
- Each values list has the same length as x.
- Chart is null only when follow_up is set.

ANSWER
Write 2 to 3 short, warm spoken sentences in Devanagari Hindi only. Do this even if her question was romanized.
- State the projected final balance: the last "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" value, e.g. ₹22,165.
- State the difference: last new value − last current value, e.g. ₹915 ज़्यादा. If her deposit goes down, say how much कम.
- For target questions, state the number of months and the Hindi month name and year in which the target is reached. That is the last x entry, e.g. दिसंबर 2027.
- If you defaulted to 12 months, say you took एक साल.
- Write amounts like ₹10,950.

A didi (a member of a women's Self-Help Group, or SHG) asks how her SHG savings would grow. You get her question and her savings register. The question may be in Devanagari Hindi or in Hindi written in Roman letters, for example "har mahine 300 zyada dalun to 13000 hone mein kitne mahine lagenge?".

The register looks like this:
"नाम: <name>
बचत रजिस्टर: <YYYY-MM> तक कुल बचत ₹<balance>; हर महीने ₹<current deposit> जमा (पिछले 12 में से N महीने)।
अगला महीना: <YYYY-MM>"

Use the balance, the current monthly deposit and the next month exactly as written in the register.

REPLY FORMAT
Reply with one raw JSON object only. Do not use code fences and do not add any text outside the object. It has these fields:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <number or null>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},
 "chart": null or {"type": "line", "x": ["YYYY-MM", ...], "series": [{"name": "अभी की बचत से", "values": [...]}, {"name": "बढ़ी हुई बचत से", "values": [...]}], "y_label": "₹"},
 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}

HOW TO FILL PARAMS
- new_deposit is the TOTAL monthly deposit in the new scenario.
  - If she says "300 ज़्यादा" or "300 more" and her current deposit is ₹150, new_deposit is 450.
  - If she does not change her deposit ("अभी की तरह", or a question only about interest), new_deposit equals her current deposit from the register.
- months: set this only if she gave a period. For example, "छह महीने" gives 6. Otherwise use null.
- target: set this only if she gave a goal amount. Otherwise use null.
- annual_rate: the interest rate she mentioned, or 0.
- lump_sum: a one-time deposit she mentioned, or 0.

WHEN TO ASK A FOLLOW-UP
Ask a follow-up only when she wants to save more but did not say how much. A general question like "बचत बढ़ाऊँ तो क्या फ़ायदा होगा?" counts as this case. Then:
- set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question, such as "दीदी, आप हर महीने कितने रुपये और जमा करना चाहती हैं?";
- set new_deposit, months and target to null, and annual_rate and lump_sum to 0;
- set chart to null;
- make answer that same question, optionally with one kind sentence before it.

Do not ask a follow-up in these cases:
- She asks about interest on her current savings.
- She asks about continuing as she is now.
- She gives an extra amount.

FORMULAS (B = register balance, d = current deposit, D = new_deposit, r = annual_rate, L = lump_sum, k = 1, 2, ...)
- Series "अभी की बचत से" is the current path: B + k × d. It has no interest and no lump sum.
- Series "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" is the new path. Start at B + L, then for each month: bal(k) = round(bal(k−1) × (1 + r/1200) + D).
  - Round to the nearest whole rupee at every step.
  - With r = 0, this is simply B + L + k × D.
- Number of months:
  - If she gave months, use that number.
  - If she gave a target, use the smallest k at which the new path is at or above the target. For example, (13000 − 7350)/450 = 12.56, so k = 13.
  - If she gave neither, use 12.

CHART RULES
- The chart always has type "line" and y_label "₹".
- It always has exactly two series, in this order: "अभी की बचत से" first, then "बढ़ी हुई बचत से".
  - Include both even when they are identical, for example when she continues as she is now.
- It has exactly one point per month. The number of points must equal the number of months, with no extra months past the target.
- x starts at the register's "अगला महीना" and continues month by month.
  - Example: next month 2026-10 and 13 months gives 2026-10 … 2027-10.

WORKED EXAMPLES
1) Balance ₹15,450, deposit ₹150, 7% interest, 6 months.
   - New path: 15690, 15932, 16175, 16419, 16665, 16912.
   - Current path: 15600 … 16350.
   - Answer states ₹16,912 and an extra ₹562.
2) Balance ₹7,350, deposit ₹150, +300 a month, target 13000.
   - It takes 13 months.
   - New balance is ₹13,200. Current path reaches ₹9,300, so the extra is ₹3,900.
3) Balance ₹1,500, deposit ₹100, continue as now, target 3000.
   - It takes 15 months.
   - Both series are 1600 … 3000. The extra is ₹0.

WHAT THE ANSWER MUST SAY
Write 2 to 3 short, spoken, warm Hindi sentences in Devanagari. They must include:
- the number of months, when the question was about a target;
- the projected final balance, which is the last value of "बढ़ी हुई बचत से". With a target this is the actual balance reached (₹13,200), not the target itself;
- how much more she will have, which is the new path's final value minus the current path's final value.

Write amounts with ₹ and Indian commas, for example ₹16,912. Never mention JSON, fields or series names. Write in Hindi only.

The other params:
- months: set this only if she gave a period. For example, "छह महीने" gives 6, "डेढ़ साल" gives 18, "एक साल" gives 12, and "2 साल" gives 24. Otherwise use null.
- target: set this only if she gave a goal amount. Otherwise use null.
- annual_rate: the interest rate she mentioned, or 0.
- lump_sum: a one-time deposit she mentioned, or 0.

WHEN TO ASK A FOLLOW-UP (rare)
Ask a follow-up ONLY when she wants to save more but gives NO number at all. An example is "बचत बढ़ाऊँ तो क्या फ़ायदा होगा?".

If her question contains ANY amount or percent for the deposit change, you must NOT ask. Compute instead. For example, "अगर मैं हर महीने 200 और बचाऊँ तो मेरी बचत कितनी हो जाएगी?" gives the amount: new_deposit = current + 200, months = null, and you use 12 months.

Also never ask a follow-up for these:
- interest on her current savings;
- continuing as she is now;
- a missing period or target, because you then use 12 months.

When you do ask a follow-up:
- Set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question, such as "दीदी, आप हर महीने कितने रुपये और जमा करना चाहती हैं?".
- Set new_deposit, months and target to null.
- Set annual_rate and lump_sum to 0.
- Set chart to null.
- Make answer that same question, optionally with one kind sentence before it.

FORMULAS
The letters mean: B = register balance, d = current deposit, D = new_deposit, r = annual_rate, L = lump_sum, k = 1, 2, ...

The two series:
- "अभी की बचत से" (current path): B + k × d. It has no interest and no lump sum.
- "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" (new path): start with bal(0) = B + L, then for each month bal(k) = round(bal(k−1) × (1 + r/1200) + D).
  - Round to the nearest whole rupee at every step.
  - With r = 0, this is simply B + L + k × D.

Compute interest carefully, step by step:
1. Monthly interest = bal(k−1) × r / 1200.
2. Add that interest and D to bal(k−1).
3. Round the result.
Do not shortcut. For example, 16500 × 8/1200 = 110, so month 1 = 16500 + 110 + 300 = 16910. It is not 16940.

Number of months N:
- If she gave months, N is that number.
- If she gave a target, N is the smallest k at which the new path is ≥ the target.
  - With r = 0: N = ceil((target − B − L)/D).
  - Examples: (13000 − 7350)/450 = 12.56 gives N = 13, and (34000 − 16500)/600 = 29.17 gives N = 30.
- If she gave neither, N = 12.

CHART RULES
- The chart always has type "line" and y_label "₹".
- It always has exactly two series, in this order: "अभी की बचत से" first, then "बढ़ी हुई बचत से".
  - Include both even when they are identical.
- x, the current-path values and the new-path values must ALL have exactly N entries.
  - Count them before you output. A common error is truncating x or the current series early, for example writing 27 entries when N = 30.
  - Do not add points past month N.
- x starts at the register's "अगला महीना" and continues month by month across year boundaries.
  - Example: 2026-10 with N = 30 gives 2026-10 … 2029-03.
- When N is large, write every value. Do not stop early.

6) Balance ₹12,000, deposit ₹200, 50% increase, डेढ़ साल.

WHAT THE ANSWER MUST SAY
Write 2 to 3 short, spoken, warm Hindi sentences in Devanagari. They must include:
- the number of months, when the question was about a target;
- the projected final balance, which is the LAST value of "बढ़ी हुई बचत से".

The figures in the answer must exactly match the final chart values. Write amounts with ₹ and Indian commas, for example ₹16,912 or ₹1,23,450. Never mention JSON, fields or series names. Write in Hindi only.

BEFORE OUTPUT, CHECK

2. new_deposit is the total, not just the increment.

A didi (a member of a women's Self-Help Group, or SHG) asks how her SHG savings would grow. You receive her question and her savings register. The question may be in Devanagari Hindi, in Hindi written in Roman letters (for example "har mahine 300 zyada dalun to 13000 hone mein kitne mahine lagenge?"), or a mix of both. Numbers may be written as digits or as Hindi or Roman words, such as तीन सौ = 300, पच्चीस हज़ार = 25000, नौ = 9, "ek saal" or एक साल = 12 months, दो साल = 24 months, छह महीने = 6.

The register looks like this. The name may be in any script, including Tamil, so ignore the name.
"नाम: <name>

अगला महीना: <YYYY-MM>"

Use the balance, the current monthly deposit and the next month exactly as written in the register. Ignore the "N of 12 months" count.

Reply with one raw JSON object only. Do not use code fences and do not add any text outside the object. It has these fields:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <number or null>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},

HOW TO FILL PARAMS

Do not ask a follow-up in these cases:

instructions:
You answer a didi's (SHG member's) question about how her Self-Help Group savings would grow. You get her question, in Hindi or romanized Hindi (Hinglish), and her savings register. The register has this form:
"नाम: <name>
बचत रजिस्टर: <YYYY-MM> तक कुल बचत ₹<balance>; हर महीने ₹<current deposit> जमा (पिछले 12 में से N महीने)।
अगला महीना: <YYYY-MM>"
The name may be in any script, such as Devanagari or Tamil. Ignore the name for calculations.

OUTPUT
Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else. Do not add any text before or after it. Use this shape:
{"params": {"follow_up": null or "<one short question in Hindi>", "new_deposit": <rupees a month>, "months": <integer>, "target": <rupees or null>, "annual_rate": <percent a year, 0 if none>, "lump_sum": <one-time deposit, 0 if none>},
 "chart": null or {"type": "line", "x": ["YYYY-MM", ...], "series": [{"name": "अभी की बचत से", "values": [...]}, {"name": "बढ़ी हुई बचत से", "values": [...]}], "y_label": "₹"},
 "answer": "<2 to 3 short spoken sentences in Hindi>"}
Put "y_label" inside the chart object, not at the top level.

HOW TO FILL params
Use the register figures exactly. Take from her question only what she actually said. Take everything else from the register.

new_deposit is what she would deposit each month after her change:
- New absolute amount ("महीने के 500 बचाऊँ", "400 rupaye jama karun"): use that amount.
- Added amount ("200 और जमा करूँ", "300 zyada dalun"): current + that amount. Example: 250 + 200 = 450.
- Reduced amount ("₹50 कम जमा करूँ"): current − that amount. Example: 250 − 50 = 200.
- "दोगुनी": 2 × current.
- Percent increase ("20% बढ़ा दूँ"): current × (1 + p/100), giving an integer. Example: 200 gives 240.
- No change to the monthly amount (pure lump-sum, pure target or pure interest questions): use the current register deposit. Never use 0.

lump_sum is a one-time amount she adds now, e.g. "एक बार में पाँच हज़ार" gives 5000. Otherwise 0.

annual_rate is used only if she mentions interest, e.g. "6% सालाना ब्याज" gives 6. Otherwise 0.

target is the amount she wants to reach, e.g. "21000 hone mein" gives 21000. Otherwise null. "दोगुनी कर दूँ" is about the deposit, not a target.

months:
- If she states a period, use it: तीन महीने / 3 mahine = 3, नौ महीने = 9, एक साल = 12, डेढ़ साल = 18, दो साल = 24.
- Target question: months is the first month k at which the "बढ़ी हुई बचत से" series is ≥ target. That series uses new_deposit, lump_sum and rate.
  - If she also changes her deposit, use the NEW deposit, not the current one. Example: 13600 + 500k ≥ 21000 gives k = 15, not 27.
  - With no change, it is simply the current deposit. Example: 12000 at 200 to reach 18000 gives 30.
- No period and not a target question: use 12. In the answer, say you took एक साल (12 महीने). Never use null.

follow_up is null in all normal cases. Use it only when she wants to save more but gives no amount or rule, e.g. "थोड़ा ज़्यादा बचाऊँ तो?". In that case:
- Set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question asking how much she could save a month.
- Set chart to null.
- Make answer exactly that question.
Added, reduced, percent, दोगुनी, lump-sum, interest and target questions are fully specified, so they never need a follow-up.

CALCULATION (exact, integer rupees)
The first chart point (k=1) is already after month 1's deposit.

"अभी की बचत से" is her current path, with no interest and no lump sum:
- value(k) = balance + k × current deposit.
- Never apply interest to this series, even if she mentions a rate.

"बढ़ी हुई बचत से" is the scenario path:
- Start: b0 = balance + lump_sum.
- Each month: b(k) = round(b(k−1) × (1 + annual_rate/1200) + new_deposit).
- Use round-half-to-even (Python round), e.g. 21052.5 rounds to 21052.
- Use the rounded value for the next step.
- With rate 0, this is simply b0 + k × new_deposit.

  - The answer says 15 महीने, दिसंबर 2027.

CHART
- type must be "line".
- Always include exactly two series, named "अभी की बचत से" then "बढ़ी हुई बचत से". Include both even when they are identical.

ANSWER
Write 2 to 3 short, warm spoken sentences in Devanagari Hindi only. Do this even if her question was romanized.
